# 2. Reflection

Comments on this code submission: thought process, what did not work, what was easy, and where you would push further. Written so a reviewer can judge **engineering judgment**, not only that tests pass.

**Doc 2 of 3** — reading order:

1. System map / how to run: **`1. Handover.md`**
2. **`2. Reflection.md`** (this file)
3. Workflow, sync list, cursor-prime: **`3. Appendix.md`**

Keep bullets; use **Title Case** headings. Prefer concrete decisions over generic claims.
